State.
3. Mr. Vipul Sharma, learned Counsel for 
SIDCUL, appearing through V.C.
4. Learned Counsel appearing for SIDCUL prays 
for and is allowed a further period of four weeks for 
filing the counter affidavit.
5. The petitioner did not take steps for effecting 
service upon respondent no.6 in compliance of order 
dated 20.04.2026 passed by this Court. Now, he 
seeks further time.

by another week at the cost of Rs.2,000/- (two 
thousand only) to be deposited by petitioner before
